summary.text: Edye Graning is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-3 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a corporate trainer.

paragraphs.text: Edye Graning lives in Vermont and earned a B.A. in organizational and child psychology from the University of Michigan.
Her career experience includes working as a corporate trainer.
Graning assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding George Till, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
